__migration_header__.title: settings.json migration preview — tribe direct subcommands → pluggable ingest router
what_changed: Replaced 3 tribe-cli direct-subcommand hook entries with equivalent 'hook ingest' calls that route through the new bearly listener registry at vendor/bearly/tools/lib/hooks/.
PreCompact  : 'tribe-cli.ts hook pre-compact'     → 'tribe-cli.ts hook ingest --event notification    --source claude --notification-type pre-compact'
SessionStart: 'tribe-cli.ts hook session-start'   → 'tribe-cli.ts hook ingest --event session_start   --source claude'
SessionEnd  : 'tribe-cli.ts hook session-end'     → 'tribe-cli.ts hook ingest --event session_end     --source claude'
All other entries (recall export --catchup --hook, recall export --hook, dcg, injection-gate.ts, bd-prime PreCompact) are untouched — they are not tribe entries and stay as-is.

UserPromptSubmit has no tribe entry in the current settings.json — nothing to migrate there. If you later want tribe's prompt hook to fire, add: 'tribe-cli.ts hook ingest --event user_prompt_submit --source claude' under UserPromptSubmit.
why: The listener registry (vendor/bearly/tools/lib/hooks/) decouples the tribe pipeline from settings.json: new listeners (kanban-bridge, future telemetry, etc.) drop into ~/.claude/hooks.d/*.ts without editing settings.json.

Behaviour stays identical: tribe.ts listener forwards session_start → dispatchHook('session-start'), user_prompt_submit → dispatchHook('prompt'), session_end → dispatchHook('session-end'), notification(pre-compact) → dispatchHook('pre-compact').
Failure isolated: the listener swallows dispatchHook errors so a tribe issue never blocks the hook session.
how_to_apply: 1. Back up the current live settings:
2. Copy (or symlink) the tribe listener into the user-global hooks.d:
# OR (preferred — picks up in-repo edits automatically):
3. Apply the 3 command replacements shown in settings-migration-preview.diff (either by hand or via the jq one-liner below).
4. Start a fresh Claude Code session and verify tribe broadcasts still fire end-to-end. Useful sanity probes:
- SessionStart:  'bd prime' catchup runs, tribe daemon autostarts, no errors in terminal.
- SessionEnd:    session close is broadcast via tribe.send.
- PreCompact:    /compact works; tribe receives the checkpoint ping.
Tail dispatch logs to confirm the listener fired: BEARLY_HOOKS_DEBUG=1 is honoured by the tribe-cli hook subcommand.
__migration_header__.jq_apply_oneliner: BUN=/nix/store/4ry96w6s7jql71336lfm31m7fwn3ri2d-bun-1.3.11/bin/bun; CLI=/Users/beorn/Code/pim/km/vendor/bearly/tools/tribe-cli.ts; jq --arg bun "$BUN" --arg cli "$CLI" '(.hooks.PreCompact[]?.hooks[]? | select(.command | test("tribe-cli.ts hook pre-compact")) | .command) |= "\($bun) \($cli) hook ingest --event notification --source claude --notification-type pre-compact" | (.hooks.SessionStart[]?.hooks[]? | select(.command | test("tribe-cli.ts hook session-start")) | .command) |= "\($bun) \($cli) hook ingest --event session_start --source claude" | (.hooks.SessionEnd[]?.hooks[]? | select(.command | test("tribe-cli.ts hook session-end")) | .command) |= "\($bun) \($cli) hook ingest --event session_end --source claude"' ~/.claude/settings.json > ~/.claude/settings.json.migrated && mv ~/.claude/settings.json.migrated ~/.claude/settings.json
__migration_header__.non_destructive_note: This file is a PREVIEW only — it does NOT modify ~/.claude/settings.json. Apply by hand or with the jq one-liner above. See settings-migration-preview.diff for the exact unified diff.
